description: This file implements authentication context for a React application, providing login, logout, and authentication state management via React Context API. It handles persistent storage of auth tokens and user data using localStorage and sessionStorage, and exposes hooks and components for other parts of the app to access authentication status.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to child components, managing login and logout workflows, and persisting auth data.

methods.name: readPersistedAuth
methods.description: Reads token and user data from localStorage or sessionStorage to initialize auth state.

methods.name: clearAllStorage
methods.description: Removes token and user data from both local and session storage.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by calling the auth API, updating auth state, and persisting data based on 'remember' flag.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs logout by calling logout API, clearing auth state and storage.
